name: MCP — State Export
flow: Two triggers converge on Check Access (code: webhook requests must carry query token; manual/MCP runs pass) and GET /state-export (webhook GET path state-export, responseMode lastNode). Authorized? (if) -> TRUE: Get Positions (State) (positions_state all, alwaysOutputData) -> Get Ledger (State) (trade_ledger all, executeOnce, alwaysOutputData) -> Get Briefs (State) (daily_brief all, executeOnce, alwaysOutputData) -> Assemble State (code: { positions, ledger_recent [30d], latest_brief|null, generated_at }); FALSE: Unauthorized (set {error:'unauthorized'}).
usage: MCP: execute_workflow (manual, no inputs), read the Assemble State node output from the execution. Fallback: GET https://{{N8N_HOST}}/webhook/state-export?token={{BRIDGE_TOKEN}}. Token lives in the Check Access code node.
_note: Condensed export 2026-08-11. Live workflow is source of truth: your n8n instance, workflow {{WF_STATE_EXPORT_ID}}. Token intentionally not committed.
